summary.text: 14 years building cloud platforms and developer tooling for regulated industries. Leads teams of 6 to 12 engineers through platform migrations on Kubernetes and AWS.

bullets.text: Designed an internal developer platform for 220 engineers that cut new service setup from 2 weeks to 1 day
Led migration of 40 services from VMs to Kubernetes on AWS EKS, cutting infrastructure cost 30%
Set HIPAA-aligned guardrails for CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions
Built an LLM-based support triage service with Python and AWS Bedrock handling 5000 tickets per month
Introduced Docker and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, cutting release time from monthly to weekly
Built payment APIs in Java and Spring Boot processing 2 million transactions per day
